key_insight: VibeVideoBench evaluates multimodal agents that generate videos by writing code to render frames and synthesize sound. It targets precise, rule-following content that visually impressive diffusion video models still struggle to produce reliably.
problem_solved: Video generation needs more than visual realism: formulas must be exact, charts correct, game rules consistent, and narration synchronized with on-screen events. This benchmark assesses agents on these code-driven video creation challenges.
method: Introduce 239 self-contained video-generation tasks in English and Chinese.
Cover 12 task categories, including data stories and music-driven content.
Evaluate multimodal agents on generating videos through code-based frame rendering and sound synthesis.
impact: The benchmark gives practitioners a structured way to assess code-driven video generation beyond visual appeal. It focuses attention on capabilities important for educational, analytical, and rule-based video applications.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: task instructions → multimodal agent → rendering and audio code → video.
Benchmark snapshot highlighting 239 tasks, 12 categories, and 2 languages.
Precision icons representing exact formulas, correct charts, consistent game rules, and synchronized narration.
Side-by-side concept illustration contrasting visual realism with content correctness.
paper_title: VibeVideoBench:Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Code-Driven Video Generation
paper_authors: Muxi Diao, Wenbin Xu, Lele Yang, Xuyang Ma, Yuzhe Chen
